missing_scene_fields: Whether the opposing-direction lane is fully closed or only locally occupied/restricted
Confirmed roadway configuration and lane count
Traffic-control method for alternating traffic: flaggers, low-volume yield control, temporary traffic control signals, or another method
Traffic volume or confirmed existence of sufficient gaps for TA-11
Confirmed sight distance through and beyond the worksite for TA-11
Exact work-area limits relative to the all-way-stop intersection
Whether the channelized area is in the traveled way or instead a shoulder/other roadside area
selection_reason: The retrieved manual evidence identifies TA-10 as the two-lane-road lane-closure application using flaggers, TA-11 as its low-volume alternate when sufficient gaps and visibility exist, and TA-12 as the temporary-signal alternative. The scene supports a possible two-way roadway lane obstruction but does not establish the closure extent or the control method. Those unresolved facts distinguish mutually exclusive primary Typical Applications, so no primary TA can be selected without guessing.
